fusions.name: Sharp-Eared Shot
fusions.desc: Flicks a stone that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: you run it down and deal 24 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.2 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Flushed From Cover
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more power, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Distance
fusions.desc: Against an enemy at low health, your damage rises by 12%. Your dodge chance rises by 5% at all times.
